items.text: How much life insurance do you actually need? Start with what it would cover: a mortgage or rent, income your family relies on, debts, schooling and final costs. Then subtract savings and any coverage you already have through work. We walk through that math with you, then compare term and whole life options from several insurers. Licensed in VA, MD, GA, TX, MI, NC, SC, AL, LA, IN and WV. Call (571) 354-0146.
